title: A signal to ovarian follicles
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Follicle-stimulating hormone helps stimulate ovarian follicle development. Ovarian function also depends on other hormones and feedback.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which anterior-pituitary hormone helps stimulate ovarian follicle development? Follicle-stimulating hormone helps stimulate ovarian follicle development. Ovarian function also depends on other hormones and feedback.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases FSH into the circulation? Follicle-stimulating hormone helps stimulate ovarian follicle development. Ovarian function also depends on other hormones and feedback.
